Choose the election, round, office, territory and income reference in each
panel. Each view keeps its own selection and hover. On small screens,
the panels are stacked vertically.

::: {.callout-warning title="Income describes the tract, not the voter"}
The panels reuse the [explorer's methodology](index.qmd). Income is the
Census 2022 tract mean, including for past elections; it does not identify
individual voters' income. Spatial coverage may vary by election.
Check each panel's notices, sources and coverage.
:::
